mealBalanceCheck.heading: Meal Balance Check
mealBalanceCheck.subtitle: Delivered via email | £39
mealBalanceCheck.highlight: A quick, affordable way to get expert eyes on your diet — with practical tips you can use straight away.
mealBalanceCheck.description: This service gives you a clear picture of how balanced your meals are, where you might have gaps in nutrition, and what small changes can make a real difference to your energy levels and overall wellbeing.
mealBalanceCheck.idealIf: You want a simple starting point to understand whether your diet is supporting your gut health — without a full consultation.
step1Bullets: Take photos of everything you eat and drink for 5 days
Include meals, snacks, and drinks — no need to weigh anything
step2Bullets: Analyse meal balance, protein, fibre and key nutrient gaps
Check food combinations and meal timing
Identify areas that may affect energy, digestion or mood
mealBalanceCheck.step3Title: 3. You receive personalised feedback within 5 working days
step3Bullets: Practical tips to improve digestion & energy
Basic supplement advice & review of current intake
mealBalanceCheck.followUp: After receiving your feedback, you'll have 5 days of follow-up support via email, WhatsApp, or Telegram to ask questions and clarify recommendations.
mealBalanceCheck.important: This service provides general nutrition feedback based on your food diary. If you have chronic conditions, digestive disorders, food allergies, or take prescribed medications, a full consultation may be more appropriate. No refund is available once feedback has been delivered.

quiz.title: What's Causing Your Bloating?
quiz.subtitle: Answer 6 quick questions to find out — and get a free 3-day meal plan
quiz.q1: When does your bloating usually happen?
quiz.q2: Which foods seem to make it worse?
quiz.q2a1: Milk, milky coffee, ice cream, cakes with cream
quiz.q2a3: No specific food — it happens randomly
quiz.q3: How would you describe your eating speed?
quiz.q3a1: I eat quickly, often on the go; I often talk when I eat
quiz.q4: Do you experience any of these alongside bloating?
quiz.q5: How would you describe your stress levels?
quiz.q6a1: I eat at regular times each day
quiz.q6a2: I skip meals or eat at irregular times
quiz.typeADesc: Your bloating pattern suggests that dairy products may be a key trigger. Many people struggle to digest lactose properly, which can cause bloating, gas, and discomfort after eating dairy.
quiz.typeBDesc: Your bloating pattern suggests that certain fermentable carbohydrates (FODMAPs) may be triggering your symptoms. These are found in foods like onions, garlic, wheat, beans, and some fruits.
quiz.typeCDesc: Your bloating pattern suggests that eating habits, meal timing, and stress may be key contributors. This type of bloating is often linked to how and when you eat, rather than specific foods.
quiz.getYourPlanDesc: Enter your details below to download your personalised gut reset plan.

about.heading: About me
about.journeyPara1: My interest in nutrition began during my late teens, when I was diagnosed with PCOS. Curious about the relationship between food, lifestyle, and health, I started a degree in Pharmacology — then became increasingly drawn to nutrition as a way to complement clinical care.
about.journeyPara2: That curiosity eventually took me back to university. I completed my MSc in Dietetics at Teesside and became a Registered Dietitian — now applying the same evidence-based approach with my own clients.
journeyMilestones: Completed BSc Pharmacology at University of East Anglia
Studied Integrative and Preventive Nutrition at MIIN
Completed MSc in Dietetics at Teesside University
Registered as a Dietitian with the HCPC (DT034558)
Currently practising as a Gastroenterology Dietitian in the NHS
about.journeyClosing: Today, my private practice is grounded in evidence-based dietetic care, with a particular focus on gut health and the connections between digestion, nutrition, and overall wellbeing.

consent.transparencyBody: Anna Doran Health (HCPC DT034558, ICO CSN1032456) is the data controller responsible for your information. I process it to provide you with safe dietetic care, under UK GDPR Article 6(1)(b) and Article 9(2)(h) — the lawful basis that applies to regulated health professionals. Your records are retained for 8 years, in line with British Dietetic Association guidance. I use a small number of trusted third-party services to run the practice — full details are in my Privacy Policy. If you are ever unhappy with how your information is handled, you have the right to raise the matter with the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk / 0303 123 1113).
consent.safeguardingBody: What you share with me is treated as confidential and used only to support your care. There are limited circumstances in which I may need to share information — for example, where there is a serious concern for your safety or someone else's, or where I am legally required to do so. If this ever arises, I will discuss it with you beforehand whenever possible.
consent.withdrawalBody: You can withdraw your consent at any time by emailing me at contact@annadorandiet.com. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing already carried out. If you withdraw the core consent, our dietetic relationship will end; the retention period stated above will still apply, as required by my professional body.
consent.title: Client Consent Form
consent.intro: Welcome. Before we begin working together, I'd like you to read through a few things — how I work, how I look after your information, and what to expect from your sessions. It should only take a couple of minutes.
consent.name: Full name
consent.consent1: I understand that consultations take place online via video call. Working remotely has limitations compared to meeting in person — Anna cannot physically examine me, and we rely on the information I provide about myself. Anna is a registered dietitian, not a medical doctor, and works within her professional scope of practice. If she identifies anything that requires urgent medical attention (for example significant unexplained weight loss, GI bleeding, severe pain, or signs of self-harm), she will ask me to contact my GP, NHS 111, or 999, and may pause our work together until I have been seen by a medical professional. Online consultations are not appropriate for medical emergencies.
consent.consent2: I confirm that I am 18 or over and have capacity to give my own consent. I agree that Anna Doran Health may collect and process my health information — including dietary details, symptoms, medical history, and food diaries — for the purpose of providing dietetic care. This is permitted under UK GDPR Article 6(1)(b) and Article 9(2)(h), the lawful basis that applies to regulated health professionals.
consent.consent3: I understand that results are not guaranteed and that everyone responds differently. Anna's advice is grounded in her professional expertise, but outcomes also depend on my individual circumstances and how I apply the recommendations in practice.
consent.consent4: I agree that Anna may contact my GP to share relevant information about our consultations and any dietary recommendations, where appropriate.
consent.note: By submitting this form, you are confirming that you have read and understood the above, and that you agree to my
consent.noteMiddle: . For full details on how your information is handled, please see my
consent.noteEnd: If you have any concerns about how your information has been handled, you have the right to raise them with the ICO (ico.org.uk) or the HCPC (hcpc-uk.org).

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: By booking a consultation or service with Anna Doran Health, you agree to the following terms and conditions:
terms.term1: Cancellation policy: I require at least 24 hours' notice for cancellations of consultations and coaching sessions. If you cancel within 24 hours of your appointment, you will be asked to pay half of the service price.
terms.term2: Cooling-off period: Under the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013, you have the right to cancel a booking within 14 days of purchase without giving a reason. However, if you have requested that the service begins within the 14-day period (e.g., by attending a consultation or receiving your Meal Balance Check feedback), you agree to waive this right for any service already provided.
terms.term3: Meal Balance Check: After receiving your 5-day food diary, I will deliver your personalised feedback via email within 5 working days. You will then have 5 days of follow-up support via email, WhatsApp, or Telegram to ask questions. No refund is available once feedback has been delivered.
terms.term4: Initial Consultation: After the session, written materials (meal plans, recommendations, summaries) will be sent to you within 5 working days. Please ask any questions about these materials within 14 days. This does not enter you into an ongoing support agreement — if you require continued support, please book a follow-up session or coaching programme.
terms.term5: Follow-up sessions: A follow-up session is available at a discounted rate of £79 if booked within 6 months of your initial consultation. After 6 months, a new initial consultation at full price (£109) will be required.
terms.term6: Health Coaching programme: All 6 sessions must be used within a 2-month period from the date of your first session. Unused sessions after this period will expire.
terms.term7: Payments are processed securely via Stripe. I do not store your card details. Full payment is required prior to the service.
terms.term8: Refund policy: I do not offer refunds for completed services. For the Meal Balance Check, no refund is available once feedback has been delivered. For consultations, if the service has not yet been provided and you cancel outside the 24-hour period, a full refund will be issued. All services are provided with reasonable care and skill in accordance with the Consumer Rights Act 2015.
terms.term9: As a client, you are responsible for: attending your consultation on time, ensuring a stable internet connection for online sessions, and making any payments due prior to the service.
terms.term10: As an HCPC-registered Dietitian (DT034558) and member of the British Dietetic Association, all services are provided in full compliance with the professional code of conduct for dietitians as outlined by the BDA and the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC). I hold professional indemnity insurance.
terms.term11: All data held will be kept confidential and in line with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR). Please see my Privacy Policy for full details.
terms.term12: If you are asked for your GP contact details, please be aware that I may contact your GP to provide feedback on your consultation. I will always ask for your consent before doing so.
terms.term13: In the case of unforeseen circumstances such as illness, your session may be cancelled by me within 24 hours. If this happens, no payment will be due and you will be offered an alternative date as soon as possible.
terms.term14: The information and advice provided during all services is for educational and informational purposes and does not replace medical advice from your doctor or medical team. Always consult your GP before making significant changes to your diet if you have a medical condition. Results are not guaranteed and may vary from person to person.
terms.term15: Testimonials and case studies: With your consent, anonymised case studies or testimonials may be shared on my website and social media channels (including Instagram, WhatsApp, YouTube and Telegram). No identifying information such as your name, photo, or contact details will be shared without your explicit written permission. All content shared on social media is for educational purposes only and does not constitute individual medical or dietary advice.
terms.term16: Liability. I provide my services with reasonable care and skill in line with my HCPC and BDA professional obligations and hold professional indemnity insurance. To the fullest extent permitted by law, my total liability to you for any claim arising out of or in connection with the services is limited to the total fees you have paid me for the specific service giving rise to the claim. I am not liable for any indirect, consequential, or economic loss, loss of earnings, or loss of opportunity. Nothing in these terms limits my liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, for fraud, or for any other liability which cannot be excluded by law.
terms.contact: If you have any questions about these terms, please contact me at contact@annadorandiet.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.effectiveDate: Effective from 28 March 2026. This policy is regularly reviewed and updated.
privacy.intro: This privacy policy sets out how I, Anna Doran (Anna Doran Health), use and protect any personal information that you provide to me. Should I ask you to provide certain information by which you can be identified when using my services, you can be assured that it will only be used in accordance with this privacy policy and the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR).
privacy.whyCollect: I collect your personal data with your explicit consent in order to provide my independent nutrition and dietetic services to you. You may also have opted in to receive my newsletter.
privacy.lawfulBasis: I process your personal data under Article 6(1)(b) UK GDPR (performance of a contract) when you book a paid service, and Article 6(1)(a) (consent) for the newsletter and contact form enquiries.
privacy.lawfulBasisHealth: Health and dietary information is special category data under Article 9 UK GDPR. As an HCPC-registered dietitian, I process this data under Article 9(2)(h) (provision of health care by a health professional under a duty of confidentiality), read with Schedule 1 Part 1 paragraph 2 of the Data Protection Act 2018. Where I share information with your GP or another healthcare professional, I will obtain your separate explicit consent (Article 9(2)(a)) before doing so.
privacy.collect1: Name, date of birth, age, sex, next of kin, GP name and address, marital status, living arrangements and occupation.
privacy.collect2: Contact details: home address, email and telephone numbers.
privacy.collect3: Clinical and health-related information via forms, emails and verbally during a consultation. This includes dietary information, symptoms, medical history, and food diaries.
privacy.collect4: Payment information processed securely by Stripe. I do not store your card details — these are handled entirely by Stripe in compliance with PCI DSS standards.
privacy.usedFor1: Professional clinical record keeping of client information in accordance with the British Dietetic Association Guidance for Records and Record Keeping.
privacy.usedFor2: Sharing information with relevant healthcare professionals such as your GP or medical team (your separate consent will always be obtained before this is done).
privacy.usedForException: In exceptional circumstances, information about a client may be disclosed without consent if it is in the public interest to do so. This might be in circumstances where disclosing the information is necessary to prevent a serious crime or serious harm to other people.
privacy.websiteDataHeading: What information is collected via this website
privacy.websiteData1: When you visit this website, your browsing data may be collected anonymously to help me understand how the site is used. No data is collected which could identify an individual.
privacy.websiteData2: This website uses cookies to help provide a better user experience. Please see the Cookie Policy for full details. You may disable cookies in your browser if you prefer.
privacy.websiteData3: If you subscribe to the newsletter, your email address is stored securely and used only to send you regular updates. You are free to unsubscribe at any time.
privacy.websiteData4: When you submit the contact form, your name, email, selected service, and message are saved securely. A notification containing these details is sent to me via Telegram, a messaging service operated outside the UK. By submitting the form, you consent to this international data transfer.
privacy.thirdPartyIntro: I use the following third-party services to operate my business. Each provider has their own privacy policy and data protection measures:
privacy.thirdParty1: Stripe — payment processing. Your card details are handled securely by Stripe and are never stored on my systems.
privacy.thirdParty2: MailerLite — email newsletter. Your name and email are stored to send you nutrition updates you have subscribed to.
privacy.thirdParty3: Telegram — I receive an instant notification when you submit a contact or consent form, so I can respond promptly. The notification contains only your name, email and basic contact preferences — it never includes the contents of your message or any health information. Full submission details are stored only in my secure admin system. Telegram's servers are located outside the UK.
privacy.thirdParty4: Contabo (server hosting) — the website and database are hosted on secure servers in Europe.
privacy.thirdParty5: Zoom — used for online video consultations. Audio and video are transmitted in real time and are not recorded unless separately agreed with you in writing. Zoom is bound by its own GDPR-aligned Data Processing Agreement; servers are located in multiple regions including the US.
privacy.thirdParty6: Microsoft Teams — also used for online video consultations. Audio and video are transmitted in real time and are not recorded unless separately agreed with you in writing. Microsoft Teams offers UK data residency under its Data Processing Addendum.
privacy.control1: I will not distribute, sell or lease your personal information to third parties unless I have your explicit permission or am required by law to do so.
privacy.control2: You may request details of personal information which I hold about you under the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR). If you believe that any information I am holding on you is incorrect or incomplete, please contact me as soon as possible and I will promptly correct it.
privacy.control3: All service providers used to store and process information related to carrying out dietetic services have robust security procedures in place and are GDPR compliant. BDA and HCPC record-keeping guidelines are strictly adhered to for one-to-one consultations.
privacy.retention: Records relating to the care of a client will be stored for eight years, in line with British Dietetic Association Guidance for Records and Record Keeping. Contact form enquiries are retained for 12 months. Payment records are retained for six years in accordance with HMRC requirements.
privacy.right1: The right to access the personal data we hold about you (Subject Access Request).
privacy.right2: The right to request correction of any inaccurate data.
privacy.right3: The right to request deletion of your data (right to be forgotten).
privacy.right4: The right to restrict or object to processing of your data.
privacy.right6: The right to withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.
privacy.rightsICO: If you are unhappy with how your data has been handled, you have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk.
privacy.controller: I (Anna Doran, HCPC registered dietitian DT034558) am the data controller at Anna Doran Health. Please contact me at contact@annadorandiet.com with any queries or requests related to your personal data and I will respond promptly.
